verdict.rationale: Kling's docs claim multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control covering pan, tilt, zoom, dolly and handheld, so creators can direct pan and zoom moves rather than accept model-chosen motion. Orbit and static (locked-off) shots, two of the four moves in the story, are not named. The 'Motion Control' pricing line does not say it covers camera moves, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented orbit camera move, documented static/locked camera option, hands-on or independent verification that camera directives are followed, in-depth docs on how camera control is specified (UI/API parameters).

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks

citations.quote: Multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, handheld) up to 6 cuts
